name: Olecranon-tip approach for ulnar intramedullary nailing
corridor: Straight 1 cm longitudinal cut at the olecranon tip with the arm pronated, splitting triceps tendon to bone for antegrade ulnar nailing

positioning.text: Position supine with the arm pronated on an arm table so the olecranon tip is accessible.

surface_landmarks.text: Palpate the tip of the olecranon.

incision.text: Make a straight longitudinal cut about 1 cm long at the olecranon tip. This is a limited nail-entry window, not the full posterior-arm triceps split that starts at the same landmark.

superficial_interval.text: Incise skin and subcutaneous tissue over the olecranon tip down to the triceps tendon.

deep_interval.text: Split the triceps tendon down to bone at the olecranon tip to enter the ulnar canal. Do not convert this 1 cm window into a shaft exposure.

layers.text: Skin, triceps tendon, olecranon tip, then the ulnar medullary canal.

structures_at_risk.text: The triceps tendon and olecranon articular surface are at risk if the split is uncontrolled. This short entry does not reach the radial nerve of a full posterior humeral split.

danger_zones.text: Missing the olecranon tip and skiving into the joint, or lengthening the cut into a full posterior-arm approach without identifying the radial nerve, are the danger zones.

retraction_hazards.text: Keep the tendon split only as wide as the nail entry requires.

exposure.text: Shows only the olecranon-tip entry for antegrade ulnar nailing.

limitations.text: Does not expose the ulnar shaft for plating. Pediatric elastic nailing uses metaphyseal windows and specifically avoids an olecranon portal.

indications.text: Used to insert an antegrade ulnar intramedullary nail through the olecranon tip.

closure.text: Repair the triceps split and close the short skin cut.

complications.text: Complications include triceps irritation at the olecranon entry and intra-articular skiving.

procedure_applications.condition: The ulna is nailed antegrade through the olecranon tip rather than plated

questions.question: How is the arm positioned for ulnar nail entry?
questions.answer: Supine with the arm pronated on an arm table.

questions.question: How long is the olecranon-tip incision and what is split?
questions.answer: About 1 cm, splitting the triceps tendon down to bone.
